Ed had been head of investment research at an investment bank. I had been investing since I was 15, initially with more enthusiasm than wisdom. By the time we met, we had both noticed something. Everyone seemed to agree about Britain. Unloved. The UK stock market had become the financial equivalent of a seaside town in November. We thought this was wonderful.
